job.eternalrealm.knight.desc: Iron defender. +15% HP, stronger guard. Draws enemies away from allies.
job.eternalrealm.assassin.desc: Dual-blade killer. Higher critical chance and damage, cheaper dodges.
job.eternalrealm.mage.desc: Wields magic with a staff. +20% magic damage from a distance.
job.eternalrealm.ranger.desc: Master archer. +15% ranged damage and faster movement.
job.eternalrealm.priest.desc: Healer. +30% healing. Heals and blesses allies; holy light smites the undead.
job.eternalrealm.spellblade.desc: Swords infused with magic. Half of INT also powers physical attacks.
skill.eternalrealm.knight_shield_bash.de: Strikes ahead and slows enemies for 3 s.
skill.eternalrealm.knight_war_cry.desc: Taunts enemies within 12 blocks; takes 30% less damage for 8 s.
skill.eternalrealm.knight_iron_wall.desc: Shield of 30% max HP and 50% less damage; nearby allies take 20% less.
[Ultimate] Gathers power and smashes everything within 6 blocks.
Dashes forward and cuts enemies around the landing spot.
Three cuts; the last makes the target bleed for 5 s.
skill.eternalrealm.assassin_smoke_bomb.d: Turns invisible, speeds up and makes nearby enemies lose track of you.
skill.eternalrealm.assassin_thousand_bla: [Ultimate] Cuts everything around you ten times.
skill.eternalrealm.mage_fireball.desc: A fireball that explodes on impact and burns enemies.
skill.eternalrealm.mage_ice_lance.desc: A piercing lance of ice that freezes and slows enemies.
skill.eternalrealm.mage_thunderstorm.des: Lightning strikes up to 5 enemies within 12 blocks, twice.
skill.eternalrealm.mage_meteor.desc: [Ultimate] Calls a meteor down where you look: a huge explosion.
skill.eternalrealm.ranger_rapid_shot.des: Looses three arrows in quick succession.
skill.eternalrealm.ranger_spread_shot.de: Fires five arrows in a fan.
skill.eternalrealm.ranger_leap_shot.desc: Leaps back while firing a strong, slowing arrow.
skill.eternalrealm.ranger_arrow_rain.des: [Ultimate] Rains arrows on the area 10 blocks ahead.
skill.eternalrealm.priest_heal.desc: Heals you and allies within 8 blocks.
skill.eternalrealm.priest_holy_light.des: A bolt of holy light; double damage to the undead.
skill.eternalrealm.priest_blessing.desc: Allies within 10 blocks: +20% damage and regeneration for 10 s.
skill.eternalrealm.priest_sanctuary.desc: [Ultimate] Greatly heals and protects allies and smites nearby foes.
skill.eternalrealm.spellblade_arcane_edg: A slash wrapped in magic (magic damage).
skill.eternalrealm.spellblade_flame_blad: For 10 s: +25% damage and melee hits set enemies on fire.
Sends a piercing wave of mana.
skill.eternalrealm.spellblade_dimension_: [Ultimate] Dashes in and cuts space itself, then again a moment later.

area.eternalrealm.arcelia.desc: The royal capital every adventurer calls home, ringed by gentle plains where monsters and bandits now prowl the roads.
area.eternalrealm.elder_forest.desc: A deep forest roofed by ancient trees, where maddened spores and vines turn away intruders.
area.eternalrealm.sandria_desert.desc: A sun-scorched desert where an ancient temple sleeps beneath the sand; only the caravans know the way.
area.eternalrealm.nordia_snowfield.desc: A silver land of endless blizzards, with an ice castle and a frozen prison at its northern edge.
area.eternalrealm.dragonia_volcano.desc: A land of lava rivers ruled by dragonkin, where the Dragon King stirs deep in the searing caves.
area.eternalrealm.celestia.desc: A continent adrift above the clouds, home to the ruins of an ancient civilization and clockwork sentinels that never stopped.
area.eternalrealm.tower_of_the_end.desc: A black tower at the edge of the world, the final ground where the King of the End awaits.
message.eternalrealm.world.final_boss_un: All eight bosses have fallen. The way to the King of the End opens...

quest.eternalrealm.m1_arrival.desc: Meet the knight captain of Arcelia and enlist as an adventurer.
quest.eternalrealm.m1_hunt.desc: Thin out the meadow slimes and wandering dead overrunning the plains.
quest.eternalrealm.m1_dungeon.desc: Descend into the old city beneath the capital and find the bandits' hideout.
quest.eternalrealm.m1_boss.desc: Defeat the Bandit King deep in the undercity and open the road to the forest.
quest.eternalrealm.m2_arrival.desc: Enter the Elder Forest and hear of the disturbance from the sage.
quest.eternalrealm.m2_hunt.desc: Slay the frenzied forest spiders and witches to calm the woods.
quest.eternalrealm.m2_dungeon.desc: Fight through the labyrinth deep within the roots of the ancient tree.
quest.eternalrealm.m2_boss.desc: Subdue the maddened guardian of the ancient tree and open the way to the desert.
quest.eternalrealm.m3_arrival.desc: Reach the Sandria Desert and hear the caravan master's rumors of the temple.
quest.eternalrealm.m3_hunt.desc: Hunt the sand husks and giant scarabs that raid the caravans.
quest.eternalrealm.m3_dungeon.desc: Brave the buried temple and reach its innermost chamber.
quest.eternalrealm.m3_boss.desc: Defeat the Colossus of the Sandstorm and open the way north.
quest.eternalrealm.m4_arrival.desc: Reach the Nordia Snowfield and ask the chieftain for help.
quest.eternalrealm.m4_hunt.desc: Defeat the frozen dead and snowfield archers threatening the village.
quest.eternalrealm.m4_dungeon1.desc: Infiltrate the ice-locked prison and learn what became of its captives.
quest.eternalrealm.m4_boss1.desc: Defeat the executioner who rules the frozen prison.
quest.eternalrealm.m4_dungeon2.desc: Conquer the frozen castle at the edge of the snowfield.
quest.eternalrealm.m4_boss2.desc: Defeat the queen who brings eternal winter and open the way to the volcano.
quest.eternalrealm.m5_arrival.desc: Reach Dragonia Volcano and meet the dragonforge smith.
quest.eternalrealm.m5_hunt.desc: Hunt lava slimes and crater blazes to secure the road to the forge.
quest.eternalrealm.m5_dungeon.desc: Conquer the searing cave where the Dragon King sleeps.
quest.eternalrealm.m5_boss.desc: Defeat the awakened Dragon King and open the way to the sky.
quest.eternalrealm.m6_arrival.desc: Reach Celestia and receive the oracle's revelation.
quest.eternalrealm.m6_hunt.desc: Defeat the cloud phantoms and sky archers.
quest.eternalrealm.m6_dungeon.desc: Conquer the ruins of the ancient civilization and find the Machine God.
quest.eternalrealm.m6_boss.desc: Stop the rampaging Machine God and open the way to the Tower of the End.
quest.eternalrealm.m7_arrival.desc: Reach the Tower of the End and hear of the final battle from the tower watcher.
quest.eternalrealm.m7_hunt.desc: Defeat the void wanderers and knights of the end guarding the tower.
quest.eternalrealm.m7_dungeon.desc: Climb the tower toward the gate of the king's hall.
quest.eternalrealm.m7_boss.desc: Defeat the Gatekeeper of the End guarding the king's hall.
quest.eternalrealm.m7_final.desc: Join forces with the whole server and bring down the King of the End.
quest.eternalrealm.s1_slime_gel.desc: Collect meadow slime gel for the item shop.
quest.eternalrealm.s2_forest_spores.desc: Defeat vine creepers and gather forest spores for medicine.
quest.eternalrealm.s3_tomb_warden.desc: Defeat the tomb warden and bring back desert crystals.
quest.eternalrealm.s4_yeti_hunt.desc: Hunt snowfield yetis and gather their fur.
quest.eternalrealm.s5_drake_scales.desc: Defeat a dragonkin berserker and gather drake scales.
quest.eternalrealm.s6_star_fragments.des: Defeat a celestial paladin and gather star fragments.
quest.eternalrealm.daily_plains_patrol.d: Defeat 15 monsters in the Kingdom of Arcelia.
quest.eternalrealm.daily_desert_supplies: Collect 8 scarab shells for the caravan.
quest.eternalrealm.daily_tower_vigil.des: Defeat 25 monsters at the Tower of the End.

dialogue.eternalrealm.arcelia_knight_cap: Welcome, adventurer. The kingdom trembles at the signs of the End. Lend us your strength.
The forest weeps... the voice of the ancient tree has turned to madness.
dialogue.eternalrealm.sandria_caravan_ma: You crossed the sea of sand? If it's the temple you're after, no one knows more than us caravaners.
dialogue.eternalrealm.nordia_chieftain.g: This winter will not end. Since the queen awoke, our village only grows colder.
dialogue.eternalrealm.dragonia_blacksmit: A blade forged in dragonfire never breaks. But with the Dragon King on a rampage, that's another story.
dialogue.eternalrealm.celestia_oracle.gr: The stars foretell it: the gate of the Tower of the End will soon open.
dialogue.eternalrealm.tower_watcher.gree: This is the edge of the world. Atop the tower, the King of the End awaits.
